message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with a prominent masthead reading "TEMPO" in large black capital letters. An illustration of a man with grey hair, a mustache, and a dark collared shirt occupies the left side. He is rendered in a comic-book style with pink dot patterns on his skin. His right hand holds a red electrical plug with three yellow, star-tipped prongs, pointing them toward two square wall sockets. The first socket is white with two round holes; the second is yellow and features five red stars arranged like the flag of China inside its circular opening.

Text at the top includes "PUTUSAN SUMBANG HAKIM PARLAS NABABAN" and "TOKOH SENI TEMPO 2015" separated by a slash. Below the main title is the date "11-17 JANUARI 2016". To the right of the man, bold white text reads "TERSENGAT LISTRIK CINA." Smaller yellow and white text below discusses "Sofyan Basir" and "35 ribu megawatt." A barcode, price "RP 39.500", and website "WWW.TEMPO.CO" appear in the bottom-left corner. A small green and yellow "45" logo is in the top-left corner.
